turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi James, Sarah here. Let us talk about your private test drive.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to compare the handling and comfort, without a rushed showroom visit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We can arrange a quieter appointment and a route that lets you assess both. Would you also like to compare the interior and driver assistance options?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. But please do not tell me every option is essential. (laughs)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Fair enough. We will focus on what you actually use, explain the differences, and confirm which specification is available before the appointment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is helpful. Could we review the details tomorrow afternoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, James. In this demo, we would capture those notes and request a suitable appointment.
